verdict.rationale: Alma's pricing page lists its own legal fees as flat line items (H-1B change of employer $3,000, O-1 change of employer $5,000, I-539 dependent $700). It also claims flat-rate pricing with no hidden costs and no separate RFE billing. However, nothing shows the page separating these from USCIS filing fees or premium processing fees, so whether the all-in cost is honest is only implied. missing for 10: explicit statement that USCIS filing fees are excluded or itemized separately, premium processing fee breakdown on the pricing page, an all-in cost example, independent corroboration.
